shared_budget_snapshot.accounting: peak-rate upper accounting, not a provider invoice

cost_interpretation: actual token usage valued at archived peak-rate upper estimates; not a provider invoice
forecast_interpretation: model-specific blind pilot cost and tokens per record review, including schema retries; 1.5 is a chosen planning margin, not a confidence interval or guarantee
scope_limitations: fixed pilot is not a probability sample of runtime or cost; raw string length, record mix, cache behavior, retry frequency and batching may differ in full/candidate scopes

primary_full_forecast.runtime_interpretation: elapsed job time scaled per record review including retries; ideal division by workers omits queueing, provider latency changes, and model imbalance

candidate_extra_forecast.runtime_interpretation: elapsed job time scaled per record review including retries; ideal division by workers omits queueing, provider latency changes, and model imbalance

budget_snapshot_note: Exact budget bytes preserved before the first full-stage request; numerical forecasts unchanged.
